comment: man1k.xyz respects the Global Privacy Control signal. When GPC is detected (navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true), all analytics and tracking scripts (Google Tag Manager / GTM-NT5X6BHQ) are suppressed. No cookies are set, no page_view events are fired, and no data is transmitted to third-party analytics providers. This behavior is implemented client-side in /global.js and is equivalent to honoring a DNT: 1 header.
